title: Metro Commerce 20th Anniversary Stamp Rally
titleJa: メトロコマース創立20周年スタンプラリー
organizer: Metro Commerce Co., Ltd. (株式会社メトロコマース)
description: Commemorating 20 years of Metro Commerce with an official autumn railway stamp rally across 6 Tokyo Metro Tourist Information Centers.
reward: Metro Commerce 20th Anniversary Original Sticker (first 1,000) & Can Badge (first 300)
rewardJa: メトロコマース創立20周年記念 オリジナルステッカー（先着1,000名）＆ 特製缶バッジ（先着300名）

title: The Sumida Railway 'MITATE LINE' Stamp Rally
titleJa: 東武博物館・すみだ鉄道見立て線スタンプラリー
organizer: Tobu Railway & Tobu Museum (東武鉄道・東武博物館)
description: A commemorative railway stamp circuit celebrating the 'Mitate Line' conceptual heritage route along Sumida ward, connecting the Tobu Museum, Tokyo Skytree, and historic Asakusa.
reward: Mitate Line Commemorative Sticker & Postcard (Tobu Museum Reception)
rewardJa: すみだ鉄道見立て線 特製記念ステッカー＆ポストカード（東武博物館受付にて進呈）

title: Three-Venue Letterpress & Printing Heritage Stamp Rally
titleJa: 活版印刷 三館スタンプラリー
organizer: Tokyo Printing & Book Arts Heritage Consortium
description: Collect unique letterpress embossed seal stamps across Tokyo's historic printing ateliers, paper workshops, and bookstore districts in Ichigaya, Jimbocho, and Kanda.
reward: Original Letterpress Printed Washi Bookmark (Awarded at any participating venue)
rewardJa: 特製活版印刷オリジナルしおり（各館にてプレゼント）

title: JR East Pokémon Stamp Rally 2026 (Stage 1: Yamanote Metropolitan)
titleJa: JR東日本 ポケモンスタンプラリー2026（ステージ1）
description: Official 2026 summer stamp rally held across JR East terminal stations. Collecting 6 Pokémon partner and legendary stamps completes Stage 1.
reward: Stage 1 Commemorative Clear File & Certificate (Tokyo Station JR East Travel Service Center)
rewardJa: ステージ1 達成記念オリジナルクリアファイル＆認定証（東京駅JR East Travel Service Center）

title: Tokyo Tourist Information Center Tama Circuit Stamp Rally
titleJa: 東京観光情報センター多摩周遊スタンプラリー
organizer: Tokyo Metropolitan Government (東京都産業労働局)
description: Official Tokyo Metropolitan Government summer rally promoting tourism across western Tokyo and regional hub centers, connecting Shinjuku, Haneda Airport, Keisei Ueno, and Tachikawa.
reward: Tama Regional Charm Commemorative Pin Badge & Novelty Goods
rewardJa: 多摩の魅力発信 オリジナル記念ピンズ＆ノベルティ

title: Saikyō Line 40th Anniversary Station Character Stamp Rally
titleJa: 埼京線開業40周年記念 駅キャラスタンプラリー
organizer: JR East Omiya Branch (JR東日本 大宮支社)
description: Commemorating 40 years of the JR Saikyō Line with mascot character stamps across key commuter terminals connecting Omiya, Akabane, Ikebukuro, Shinjuku, and Shibuya.
reward: Saikyō Line 40th Anniversary Station Character Sticker Sheet & Keyring
rewardJa: 埼京線40周年記念 駅キャラステッカー＆オリジナルキーホルダー

title: Detective Conan Stamp Rally 2025
titleJa: 名探偵コナンスタンプラリー2025
description: Spring tie-in anime campaign celebrating the Detective Conan feature film release across major Tokyo underground and terminal hubs.
reward: Original Detective Pin Badge & Commemorative Smartphone Wallpaper
rewardJa: 特製ピンバッジ＆オリジナル壁紙

title: JR EAST Train Stamp Rally 2025
titleJa: JR東日本 トレインスタンプラリー2025
description: Winter railway heritage rally celebrating famous Shinkansen and limited express rolling stock across Tokyo, Ueno, Tabata, and Yokohama stations.
reward: Train Stamp Rally Commemorative Rolling Stock Card & Pass Case
rewardJa: トレインスタンプラリー オリジナル記念トレインカード＆パスケース
